correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=0, binary increment decomposes at the trailing-one carry boundary. For odd q>=5, the common-prefix formula reduces all six patterns to the last two prefix digits and t truncated at four; for q=1,3 and t>=6 the exceptional transitions are directly calculated. In any 14-position window at most one increment has 2-adic order at least four. Enumerating all 64 phases and every possible exceptional bit proves all eventual run lengths are in the finite set and every change is followed by a change at distance <=8; the first 145 symbols cover every possible start before index 128, including origin-only anomalies. Exact rational phase weights establish each limiting frequency, and all expected length-weighted sums equal one. The packaged standalone verifier successfully replayed these local cases and long-prefix cross-checks. Finite sample checks alone are not the proof.

value.rationale: Determines all allowable and forbidden maximal constant-run lengths and every exact rational run-start frequency for the complete natural family of six mixed three-digit block-counting parities. The classification uncovers nontrivial complement-pair equality of asymptotic distributions together with distinct three origin-only anomalies; these objects and statistics are directly motivated by studies of automatic digit-pattern sequences and their maximal runs. The result is an exact natural classification, not a random finite census, routine general theorem instantiation or bare computation.
